sents.en: To write his 2010 book, The 5-Factor World Diet, nutritionist Harley Pasternak traveled to the healthiest countries around the world to learn more about what made their meals extra nourishing.
sents.cn: 为了写他2010年的著作《五要素世界饮食》，营养学家哈利∙帕斯特纳克游历了全球最健康的一些国家，去了解更多让当地饮食格外滋养身心的秘诀。

sents.en: He noted that Japanese people ate a wonderful variety of seaweeds, and that Chinese people tried to include at least five different colors in every meal.
sents.cn: 他指出，日本人食用丰富多样的海藻，而中国人则力求每餐至少包含五种不同颜色的食物。

sents.en: Pasternak also came away with some valuable observations about how different the North American way of life was, compared with many other countries.
sents.cn: 帕斯特纳克还颇有心得地观察到，与许多其他国家相比，北美的生活方式截然不同。

sents.en: For starters, Americans eat much bigger portions than people in other countries.
sents.cn: 首先，美国人吃的份量比其他国家的人民大得多。

sents.en: "We don't prioritize eating seasonally or locally, and we also add lots of salt, sugar and thickening agents to our foods," explained Pasternak.
sents.cn: "我们并不优先选择应季或本地食材，还会往食物里加大量盐、糖和增稠剂，"帕斯特纳克解释道。

sents.en: Contrast that to the healthy Mediterranean, Nordic and Okinawan diets listed in Pasternak's book.
sents.cn: 与之形成对比的是帕斯特纳克书中列出的健康的地中海、北欧和冲绳饮食。

sents.en: They all seem to stick to the ethos of regional, seasonal produce.
sents.cn: 它们似乎都秉持着"本地区、应季农产品"的理念。

sents.en: For example, a traditional Mediterranean diet includes fruits, vegetables, whole grains, nuts and olive oil as the main components of nutritional intake.
sents.cn: 例如，传统地中海饮食以水果、蔬菜、全谷物、坚果和橄榄油作为营养摄入的主要组成部分。

sents.en: Fish, chicken and red wine make moderate appearances, while red meat, salt and sugar are used much less often.
sents.cn: 鱼、鸡肉和红酒适量出现，而红肉、盐和糖则很少使用。

sents.en: The benefits of a traditional Mediterranean diet have been studied since the 1970s, and researchers have found that living that olive oil life can help people lose weight, lower their heart disease risk and reverse diabetes.
sents.cn: 传统地中海饮食的益处自20世纪70年代起就受到研究，研究者发现，践行那种"橄榄油式"的生活能帮助人们减重、降低心脏病风险并逆转糖尿病。

sents.en: Most other healthy eating cultures also make meals an event·say, multiple courses around the family table, or a glass or two of red wine at a long lunch·as opposed to hastily wolfing down handfuls of cereal above the kitchen sink and calling it dinner.
sents.cn: 大多数其他健康饮食文化也把用餐变成一种仪式——比如围坐餐桌享用多道菜肴，或在悠长的午餐中喝上一两杯红酒——而不是急匆匆地在厨房水槽上方抓几把麦片、权当晚餐。

sents.en: Each of the healthy eating cultures has its own unique feature.
sents.cn: 每一种健康饮食文化都有其独特之处。

sents.en: But Pasternak did take note of one unifying factor in all of the healthy societies he observed.
sents.cn: 但帕斯特纳克确实注意到，在他所观察到的所有健康社会中，存在一个共同的要素。

sents.en: "The only overlapping feature in most of these healthy countries is that they all walk way more than the average American," said Pasternak.
sents.cn: "这些健康国家中绝大多数唯一重叠的特征，就是它们的人都比普通美国人走得多得多，"帕斯特纳克说。"所以真的，无论你吃什么，如果有人每天比你多走四英里，他们就会比你瘦得多，也比你长寿得多。

sents.en: "So really, regardless of what you're eating, if someone's walking four miles more than you each day, they're going to be a lot thinner and live a lot longer than you."
